title: Purple Mage Warrior
description: A young female character with white and lavender hair in buns stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid dark gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-inspired outfit with armored plates, holds a glowing purple energy orb in her right hand and crackling purple lightning magic in her left, with magical effects surrounding her head and hands.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian woman with long white hair tied in two buns and purple streaks, wearing a white and purple traditional fantasy outfit with armored shoulder plates, wide pants, and a flowing sash. She is in a combat stance, one hand extended forward holding a glowing purple orb with crescent moon symbol, the other hand crackling with purple lightning magic. Magical energy effects float around her head and hands, purple sparks and light trails, clean digital painting style, solid dark gray background, vibrant purple and white color scheme
